title: K/2 Ian / K-ET
author: Ian Probert
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7bxhipn
materials: Optional: Heat to 80°C for 2 hours and leave to cool – this should kill most organisms but should not chemically modify the medium too much Filter sterilize through 0.22µm filters (e.g. Millipore Steritop units) into sterile (autoclaved) polycarbonate bottles.

steps.title: Prepare Seawater Base
steps.instruction: Prepare 994 ml of seawater and adjust the pH to 8.2 using NaOH.

steps.title: Prepare Distilled Water Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a solution using 950 ml of distilled H2O, bring the total volume to 1 litre with milliQ H2O, and sterilize via 0.22µm filtration.

steps.title: Add Marine Soil Extract
steps.instruction: Add 10-30 ml of marine soil extract (ET) to the medium.

substeps.instruction: Follow the 'Soil extract for algal media by Daniel Vaulot' protocol for extract preparation
